name: Aharah
overview: The name Aharah appears in Scripture as a son of Benjamin, also known by the variants Ehi, Ahiram, and Aher, reflecting the multiple forms of his name in the biblical record. He is listed among the descendants of Benjamin in Genesis 46:21 and 1 Chronicles 8:1, emphasizing his place in the tribe's genealogy. Numbers 26:38 and 1 Chronicles 7:12 further confirm this lineage by associating Ahiram (Aharah) with specific family groups within Benjamin, highlighting the importance of his descendants in the tribal structure of Israel.
